storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: The United States launched limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island late on Monday, targeting surface-to-air missiles reportedly used against US assets. This military action occurred just before the crucial midterm elections, amid ongoing diplomatic discussions regarding the conflict. The strikes were confirmed by US Central Command and reported by Iranian social media.
